description: Validates data seed jobs for idempotency declaration, production environment protection, database reference mapping, and ownership accountability

rules.description: data-seed-spec.json must exist, be valid JSON, and declare name, command, and targetEnvironments
The seed script or binary path referenced in command must resolve to an existing file relative to the project root. A missing script path fails immediately at job start

The seed job must declare an explicit idempotency strategy via idempotencyContract (preferred) or idempotent: true with an idempotencyDescription. Without idempotency, a partial failure leaves the database inconsistent and re-running creates duplicate records

constraints.idempotent-true: When idempotent: true is used (legacy), idempotencyDescription must also be declared

rules.description: targetEnvironments must not include production or prod unless productionOverride: true is explicitly set. Seed jobs are designed for development and staging — running them in production can corrupt live data or violate GDPR/compliance requirements
rules.note: Override with productionOverride: true only when seeding production is explicitly justified

rules.description: Every entry in spec.dbRefs must be mapped to either an envKey (env var injection) or a secretName (k8s Secret reference). Unmapped DB refs mean the connection string will not be injected — the seed job fails to connect at startup
rules.note: Skipped when spec.dbRefs is empty or absent

constraints.dbRefs[].envKey-or-secretName: At least one of envKey or secretName must be declared per dbRef entry

rules.description: data-seed-spec.json must not contain TODO, FIXME, HACK, XXX, or PLACEHOLDER markers

Every data seed job must declare an idempotency contract (either idempotencyContract or idempotent: true) and an owner. Without an owner, accountability for data changes cannot be established when the seed corrupts or duplicates data

constraints.idempotency: Either idempotencyContract or idempotent: true must be declared
